top_signals.title: ‘Very, Very Strong’ Demand Fuels Global Trade Amid Supply Shocks
top_signals.summary: Three workhorses of global goods trade indicated demand remains solid as the artificial intelligence boom and energy transition help the world economy absorb shocks stemming from extreme weather, wars and tariffs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UK Economy Gets Surprise Boost From Weather, World Cup
top_signals.summary: HSBC economist Liz Martins comments on the outlook for Bank of England policy after the economy unexpectedly expanded in June, buoyed by sunny weather and the football World Cup. She speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: CK Hutchison Profit Jumps Sharply on Boost From Asset Sales
top_signals.summary: CK Hutchison Holdings Ltd.’s profit rose sharply in the first half of the year, driven by hefty gains from recent asset disposals by the Hong Kong conglomerate.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi described the visit as incompatible with Japan's position on the islands, which are an inherent part of Japanese territory.
